chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a bright festive fanfare: a quick tambourine pickup and a flourish of grace-note runs on the lead, landing on a held chord that springs straight into the waltz}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
lively accordion-like pulse-wave lead with quick grace-note runs
busy bell-buoy chimes and bright sparkle on phrase ends
light tambourine on beats two and three, brush on the downbeat
seaside festival dance, celebratory, playful and a little cheeky
